name: keeper-mcp
description: Read-only Keeper MSP posture across every client, with history, a change feed and no path to a vault secret.

keeper_api_key.title: Service Mode API key
keeper_api_key.description: The Keeper Commander Service Mode API key service-create printed. It is sent only to your Service Mode host.

keeper_base_url.title: Service Mode host
keeper_base_url.description: Your Keeper Commander Service Mode host, e.g. https://keeper-svc.example.internal:9090 (https only; run Service Mode with TLS).

keeper_mcp_read_only.title: Read-only MCP mode
keeper_mcp_read_only.description: Optional. Set to exactly 1 to remove every MCP tool that writes this connector's local files. Keeper reads stay available.

keeper_no_local_data.title: Run without a local copy
keeper_no_local_data.description: Optional. Set to 1 to refuse posture report, the one command that saves Keeper data locally. Live reads still work.

keeper_mcp_http_token.title: MCP HTTP token
keeper_mcp_http_token.description: Required only when running the MCP server with --transport http (a remote or hosted deployment). Callers must send a matching Authorization: Bearer header. Not needed for the default local stdio transport.

keeper_user_agent.title: User-Agent
keeper_user_agent.description: Optional. Overrides the User-Agent the client sends to your Service Mode host.

printing_press_client_profile.title: Client profile
printing_press_client_profile.description: Optional. The name of a client profile to bind this MCP server to.
